mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This fruit snack is composed mainly of fresh grapes and a fig, which are low in calories and have a moderate glycemic impact. For someone with diabetes, these fruits are generally a good option due to their fiber and nutrient content. It is best to combine them with protein or healthy fats to slow down the sugar absorption.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A simple fresh fruit snack consisting of green grapes and a fig.
